turns.question: How much less budget did the search campaign have left at the end of September 2026 than at the end of August 2026, using each month's last snapshot?
turns.answer: The search campaigns had 2,175 EUR less budget left at the end of September 2026 than at the end of August 2026: remaining budget was 4,305 EUR at the end of August and 2,130 EUR at the end of September (each campaign's last snapshot in the month, summed over the search channel). Late: marketing.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
